title: Zombie Outbreak: I Survived 30 Days In A Water Tower | S1E2
description:
You jumped forty meters off the Harbor Bridge seconds before it exploded. Now you're on top of a water tower with 200,000 liters of water, almost no food, and one ladder.
For sixty days the infected couldn't climb it. Tonight, one of them is on the ladder.
